source.label: The Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024, section 61, as published in the Gazette of India: "In section 194-O of the Income-tax Act, in sub-section (1), for the words 'one per cent.', the figures and word '0.1 per cent.' shall be substituted with effect from the 1st day of October, 2024."

note: Section 194-O writes its rate into the section text, so the amending Finance Act is the primary source for the rate itself; no separate CBDT notification is needed for the figure. incometaxindia.gov.in and pib.gov.in are bot-blocked to this tooling (RS3 open item 6), so the Gazette PDF is the anchor. The settlement file posts it as (ItemWithheldTax, TDS (Section 194-O)) -> LineKind.TDS.

citation.label: The Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024, section 61, establishes that the words replaced on 1 October 2024 were "one per cent.". The START of this window, 1 October 2020, is the commencement of section 194-O itself, which was NOT read from a primary source in this session, so this rule is verified:false on its window rather than on its rate.
